rationale: The catalogue as delivered is truncated before any PUDL/EIA-923 coal-share series, so no coal generation indicator name can be verified; this returns the driver leg only (Henry Hub NG=F, pre- vs post-war level shift) and should be re-run with the exact PUDL monthly coal-share series (freq=M) as indicator_b, with max_lag ~30 days for monthly dispatch response and seasonality (summer load, hydro) as key confounders.
